lines.cyr: Кажи мори Дано, ти бела Дано,
lines.lat: Kaži mori Dano, ti bela Dano,
lines.en: Tell me, Dana, fair Dana,

lines.cyr: кој ти ги даде црните очи?
lines.lat: koj ti gi dade crnite oči?
lines.en: who gave you those dark eyes?

lines.cyr: Кој ти ги даде црните очи,
lines.lat: Koj ti gi dade crnite oči,
lines.en: Who gave you those dark eyes,

lines.cyr: за нив да пијам по цели ноќи.
lines.lat: za niv da pijam po celi noḱi.
lines.en: for which I drink through the long, long nights?

lines.cyr: Некому си радост, некому си тага,
lines.lat: Nekomu si radost, nekomu si taga,
lines.en: To some you bring joy, to others sorrow,

lines.cyr: а на мене, само горка лага.
lines.lat: a na mene, samo gorka laga.
lines.en: but to me, only a bitter lie.

lines.cyr: Некому си среќа, некому си радост,
lines.lat: Nekomu si sreḱa, nekomu si radost,
lines.en: To some you bring happiness, to others joy,

lines.cyr: а на мене, бела Дано, само горка младост.
lines.lat: a na mene, bela Dano, samo gorka mladost.
lines.en: but to me, fair Dana, only a bitter youth.

lines.cyr: Што ми стори, Дано, зарем душа немаш,
lines.lat: Što mi stori, Dano, zarem duša nemaš,
lines.en: What have you done to me, Dana? Have you no soul?

lines.cyr: ќе се каеш, немој, зошто не ме земаш.
lines.lat: ḱe se kaeš, nemoj, zošto ne me zemaš.
lines.en: You will regret this, why won't you take me as your own?

lines.cyr: Виното ме гори, ракија ме печи,
lines.lat: Vinoto me gori, rakija me peči,
lines.en: The wine burns within me, the rakija sears,

lines.cyr: пусти мерак, Дано, веќе не се лечи.
lines.lat: pusti merak, Dano, veḱe ne se leči.
lines.en: this wretched longing, Dana, can no longer be cured.

lines.cyr: Некому си радост, некому си тага,
lines.lat: Nekomu si radost, nekomu si taga,
lines.en: To some you bring joy, to others sorrow,

lines.cyr: а на мене, само горка лага.
lines.lat: a na mene, samo gorka laga.
lines.en: but to me, only a bitter lie.

lines.cyr: Некому си среќа, некому си радост,
lines.lat: Nekomu si sreḱa, nekomu si radost,
lines.en: To some you bring happiness, to others joy,

lines.cyr: а на мене, бела Дано, само горка младост.
lines.lat: a na mene, bela Dano, samo gorka mladost.
lines.en: but to me, fair Dana, only a bitter youth.

lines.cyr: Ако уште љубиш, ако срце гори,
lines.lat: Ako ušte ljubiš, ako srce gori,
lines.en: If you still love, if your heart still burns,

lines.cyr: кажи нешто, Дано, срце си отвори.
lines.lat: kaži nešto, Dano, srce si otvori.
lines.en: say something, Dana, open up your heart.

lines.cyr: Каде ли си сега, далеку од мене,
lines.lat: Kade li si sega, daleku od mene,
lines.en: Where are you now, so far away from me?

lines.cyr: што ми стори, Дано, ѓавол да те земе.
lines.lat: što mi stori, Dano, ǵavol da te zeme.
lines.en: What have you done to me, Dana? May the devil take you!

lines.cyr: Некому си радост, некому си тага,
lines.lat: Nekomu si radost, nekomu si taga,
lines.en: To some you bring joy, to others sorrow,

lines.cyr: а на мене, само горка лага.
lines.lat: a na mene, samo gorka laga.
lines.en: but to me, only a bitter lie.

lines.cyr: Некому си среќа, некому си радост,
lines.lat: Nekomu si sreḱa, nekomu si radost,
lines.en: To some you bring happiness, to others joy,

lines.cyr: а на мене, бела Дано, само горка младост.
lines.lat: a na mene, bela Dano, samo gorka mladost.
lines.en: but to me, fair Dana, only a bitter youth.
